gaps.lead: 'I didn't write the graffiti,' the teenager said.
The athlete denied taking performance-enhancing drugs.
gaps.explanation: deny + having + past participle (or deny taking).

gaps.lead: He didn't pass the exam because he hadn't studied.
gaps.sentence: If he ___ , he would have passed the exam.
gaps.explanation: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participle.

gaps.lead: My laptop needs repairing before the trip.
gaps.explanation: need + -ing = need to be + participle: needs to be repaired.

gaps.lead: I would love to afford a bigger flat.
gaps.explanation: wish + subject + could = regret about ability/possibility.

gaps.lead: I last saw him in March.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect with since + point in time: haven't seen him since (March).
